This maize plot is small, and here in Somali we have to be careful with cash because the rain is uncertain. I will plant my usual local seed and use some manure if I can collect enough, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot this season. We mostly rely on family work, and I do not plan to irrigate or hire many outside workers.
